verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud documents a JavaScript runtime for building agents and custom business logic, so an automation-lifecycle question applies to this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review, or rollback of those automations. Segregated data-source updates are about data, not automation versions, so they do not count here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
